description: A store type (product, category, search, blog, post, complete) arrives with the document the editor gives a merchant — product carries the whole bound buy box; seed:false for blank. Any other type is empty and sb_page_open seeds its ROOT. TYPE is the route: /checkout and /products/{slug} need a PUBLISHED page of that type or they 404.
